name: Permanent Residence Permit

requirements.blocker_text: 2 years of temporary residence in Azerbaijan is required before applying for permanent residence.
requirements.fix_path: Hold temporary residence status for 2 continuous years.

requirements.blocker_text: A higher financial threshold applies for permanent residence via property, bank deposit, or securities: AZN 200,000 (versus AZN 100,000 for the temporary-residence equivalent grounds).
requirements.fix_path: Hold qualifying property, deposits, or securities worth at least AZN 200,000.

requirements.blocker_text: Applicants must demonstrate knowledge of Azerbaijani law and the Azerbaijani language through a commission test, unless exempt as a highly skilled migrant, a minor, or a senior over 65.
requirements.fix_path: Pass the Azerbaijani law and language commission test.

requirements.blocker_text: Highly skilled migrants, minors, and applicants over 65 are exempt from the Azerbaijani law and language commission test.

evidence_required.document: Proof of 2 years' continuous temporary residence
Azerbaijani law and language commission test result (unless exempt)

sources.title: Azerbaijan State Migration Service -- permanent residence: 2 years' prior temporary residence, AZN 200,000 threshold for property/deposits/securities, Azerbaijani law and language commission test (exemptions for highly skilled migrants, minors, seniors over 65)

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Azerbaijan). It was not confirmed whether the 2-year prior-temporary-residence requirement applies uniformly across ALL grounds (employment, family, business) or only to some -- the source presented it as a general permanent-residence prerequisite, modeled that way here, but this should be treated as the general rule rather than independently verified per ground. citizenship_after_months modeled 0 since permanent residence holders are not described as needing an additional fixed wait beyond meeting az_naturalisation.json's own 5-year residence and language conditions -- the two clocks are not modeled as stacking, consistent with this dataset's treatment of similar cases elsewhere.
